title: Turn evaluation timing into an explicit alert contract
description: Replay one alert instance at a one-minute evaluation interval. Change the pending period, recovery threshold, keep-firing period, and missing-data policy to see every state transition.

scenarios.label: Sustained latency regression
scenarios.detail: Latency remains above the firing threshold long enough to prove a persistent incident, then recovers.

scenarios.label: One transient spike
scenarios.detail: A single evaluation breaches before the signal returns to its normal range.

scenarios.label: Threshold flapping
scenarios.detail: Values repeatedly cross the firing threshold but do not always cross a lower recovery threshold.

scenarios.label: Telemetry disappears
scenarios.detail: The instance begins firing, then successful evaluations return no points before data recovers.

noDataPolicies.label: Create a No Data state
noDataPolicies.detail: After the pending period, model a separate DatasourceNoData alert that needs its own routing policy.

noDataPolicies.label: Keep the last state
noDataPolicies.detail: Hold the previous state during the gap; a separate telemetry-availability rule must catch a prolonged blind spot.
